masteryModel.contentStrategy: hybrid: reviewed canonical lesson + quiz bank backbone; Claude supplies adaptive diagnosis, re-teaching, fresh items, and Q&A

concepts.name: What Synnduit is
concepts.objective: State that Synnduit is a long-running data synchronization engine (not a one-time copy/ETL); explain 'ETL meets version control'.
concepts.remediationAngle: Contrast against a naive nightly copy script (duplicates, no history); show how remembered links + change log fix it.

concepts.name: Source vs Destination
concepts.objective: Define source (origin) and destination (lands; CSSD = DDH); classify real systems.
concepts.remediationAngle: Use the CSSD source/StarBridge table (README 5.1) as concrete grounding.

concepts.name: Engine model (you plug things in)
concepts.objective: You don't modify the engine; you implement a source connector and a destination connector, and the engine computes & applies the delta.
concepts.remediationAngle: Walk the source->engine->destination ASCII diagram; 'engine fixed, connectors yours'.

concepts.name: Delta detection (snapshot to delta)
concepts.objective: The connector emits a full snapshot; the engine processes only what changed since last run.
concepts.remediationAngle: 'Snapshot in, delta out' - engine diffs your snapshot against last run's recorded state.

concepts.name: StarBridge (bookkeeping DB)
concepts.objective: StarBridge is the SQL DB storing mappings, transactions, value changes, exceptions; one per Run.
concepts.remediationAngle: The diagram's StarBridge box; relate each stored thing to a later concept (mappings->L1.6, transactions->L1.10).

concepts.name: Mapping (source-to-destination link)
concepts.objective: A mapping is the persisted link between source ID and destination ID; it is why the same record updates, not duplicates, next run.
concepts.remediationAngle: Two-run timeline: run 1 writes a mapping row; run 2 looks it up -> Update not Create.

concepts.name: Run & Segment
concepts.objective: A Run syncs a set of entities; a Segment is one step (Migration or GarbageCollection). Order matters: parents before children migrating in, reverse for GC.
concepts.remediationAngle: The appsettings.json segment list (README 5.4); foreign-key parent/child ordering analogy.

concepts.name: iFeed & iSink (the connectors)
concepts.objective: IFeed<TEntity> = source connector (snapshot); ISink<TEntity> = destination connector (New/Create/Get/Update/Delete). You write these.
concepts.remediationAngle: Map onto L1.3's connector boxes; show StaffFeed.LoadEntities() shape.

concepts.name: POCO & attributes
concepts.objective: A POCO is the C# class for one entity type; attributes are the contract: [EntityType], [SourceSystemIdentifier], [DestinationSystemIdentifier], [EntityProperty], [DuplicationKey].
concepts.remediationAngle: Annotate Staff.cs line-by-line, one attribute at a time.

concepts.name: Transaction outcomes
concepts.objective: Every record in every run gets an outcome (NewEntityCreated, ChangesDetectedAndMerged, NoChangesDetected, Skipped, Rejected, ExceptionThrown, ...); outcomes are how you read a run.
concepts.remediationAngle: Tie to delta detection (no change -> NoChangesDetected); show a console summary block.

concepts.name: Dedup & merge (conceptual)
concepts.objective: A [DuplicationKey] lets the engine match a 'new' source record to an existing destination record and merge, instead of duplicating.
concepts.remediationAngle: Connect mapping (L1.6) + DuplicationKey (L1.9): 'no mapping yet, but the key finds the twin'.

concepts.name: Thresholds & resumability
concepts.objective: Safety features: abort thresholds (deletion/orphan/exception %) protect the destination from a bad feed; runs are resumable after a crash.
concepts.remediationAngle: The appsettings threshold settings; frame as 'guardrails against a bad snapshot'.

levels.name: Prerequisites: .NET substrate for Synnduit code
levels.sourcingRule: link external for the generic skill; author only the Synnduit-application slice

concepts.name: Using generic types
concepts.genericObjective: Read/use List<T>, IEnumerable<T>, Dictionary<K,V> - what the type parameter means.
concepts.synnduitObjective: Recognize IEntityCollection<TEntity> as a feed's return type.
concepts.remediationAngle: MS Learn generics -> show it in StaffFeed.LoadEntities() returning a collection of Staff.

concepts.name: Implementing a generic interface
concepts.genericObjective: Implement IExample<T> - supply T, implement its members.
concepts.synnduitObjective: class StaffFeed : IFeed<Staff>; class TeamSiteWebPartSink : ISink<TeamSiteWebPart> - <T> is your entity type.
concepts.remediationAngle: Walk a real sink class - interface on the left, entity type as <T>, the five methods as the contract.

concepts.name: DI & constructor injection
concepts.genericObjective: Inversion of control; a class declares dependencies in its constructor and receives them.
concepts.synnduitObjective: A sink takes its service via the constructor rather than new-ing it.
concepts.remediationAngle: MS Learn DI basics -> the sink constructor that receives its service.

concepts.name: MEF composition in Synnduit
concepts.genericObjective: Attribute-driven composition - parts are exported and discovered, not container-registered.
concepts.synnduitObjective: [Sink]/[Feed] mark discoverable parts; [Export(typeof(IService))] + [PartCreationPolicy(CreationPolicy.Shared)] publish a service; [ImportingConstructor] marks the injected constructor.
concepts.remediationAngle: Flag even for strong DI devs (they know Microsoft.Extensions.DI, not MEF). Author 'the DI you know vs the MEF Synnduit uses', then annotate a real [Export]/[ImportingConstructor] pair.

concepts.name: Interfaces & implementation
concepts.genericObjective: An interface is a contract; implementing it means supplying every member.
concepts.synnduitObjective: ISink<T> / IFeed<T> are the contracts your connectors fulfill.
concepts.authoredSource: ISink<T> member list mapped to a real sink
concepts.remediationAngle: MS Learn interfaces -> show ISink<T>'s members mapped to a real sink's methods.

concepts.name: Attributes (declarative metadata)
concepts.genericObjective: [Attribute] annotations attach metadata read by tooling/frameworks at runtime.
concepts.remediationAngle: MS Learn attributes -> annotate a real POCO attribute-by-attribute (ties into L1.9).

concepts.name: Querying a source with EF
concepts.genericObjective: DbContext, LINQ-to-Entities (.Where().Select()), and deferred execution (runs on enumeration, not when written).
concepts.synnduitObjective: A feed opens a DbContext, queries, and projects rows into POCOs.
concepts.externalSource: Microsoft Learn - EF Core / EF6 querying
concepts.remediationAngle: MS Learn EF querying -> the StaffFeed HRAD .Where().Select() projection; call out materialize-before-complex-LINQ.

concepts.name: POCOs & the nullable requirement
concepts.genericObjective: A POCO is a plain class mapped to data; EF binds columns to properties.
concepts.synnduitObjective: Synnduit requires POCO properties to be nullable; non-nullable properties cause subtle change-detection/load problems.
concepts.authoredSource: Documentation/Synnduit Requirement Poco Properties are Nullable.docx (extract) + a POCO example
concepts.remediationAngle: Extract the nullable-requirement doc; show wrong (int) vs right (int?) and why the engine needs the distinction.

levels.name: Coding: write feeds, sinks, and POCOs

concepts.name: Write a POCO
concepts.objective: Author an entity POCO: a plain C# class with [EntityType(guid, destinationSystem)], the identifier attributes ([SourceSystemIdentifier] / [DestinationSystemIdentifier]), [EntityProperty] on tracked fields, and [DuplicationKey] on the natural business key — with every property nullable.
concepts.remediationAngle: Start from Staff.cs and build the class up one attribute at a time; convert each value-type property to its nullable form (int -> int?).

concepts.name: Implement a Feed
concepts.objective: Write a source connector: [Feed(SourceSystem = typeof(...))] class XFeed : IFeed<X> whose LoadEntities() opens a DbContext, queries with LINQ, projects rows into POCOs, and returns a materialized snapshot (.ToList()).
concepts.remediationAngle: Walk StaffFeed.cs: the [Feed] attribute, IFeed<Staff>, and LoadEntities() returning .ToList() of projected Staff POCOs.

concepts.name: Implement a Sink
concepts.objective: Write a destination connector: [Sink(DestinationSystem = typeof(...))] class XSink : ISink<X> implementing New/Create/Get/Update/Delete, receiving its destination service via the constructor (injection, not new).
concepts.remediationAngle: Map ISink<T>'s five members (New/Create/Get/Update/Delete) onto a real sink; note the service arrives via the constructor.

concepts.name: Sink + CacheFeed
concepts.objective: Implement ICacheFeed<X> so the engine can re-read the destination's current state for diffing; commonly combined with the sink in one class (SinkAndCacheFeed).
concepts.remediationAngle: Why the engine needs a cache feed: to diff your snapshot against the destination's current state; show one class implementing both ISink<T> and ICacheFeed<T>.

concepts.name: Wire it up with MEF
concepts.objective: Make the parts discoverable: [Feed]/[Sink] mark the connectors; publish a shared service with [Export(typeof(IService))] + [PartCreationPolicy(CreationPolicy.Shared)]; mark the injected constructor with [ImportingConstructor].
concepts.remediationAngle: The DI you know vs the MEF Synnduit uses: annotate a real [Export]/[ImportingConstructor] pair, and show [Feed]/[Sink] as how the engine finds your parts.

concepts.name: Add it to a Run
concepts.objective: Register the new entity in a Run's appsettings.json Segments: a Migration segment to push it in (parents before children) and a GarbageCollection segment to clean it up (children before parents).
concepts.remediationAngle: The appsettings.json Segment list: place the new Migration after its parents and the GarbageCollection before them (reverse order).
